title: BST260 Final Project
text: repository contains final project BST260 (Fall 2026). project includes two analyses using public health datasets: Background-check laws firearm deaths: Examining whether restrictive state background-check laws associated changes firearm death rates using RAND firearm legislation data CDC mortality data. Outbreak severity transmission mode: Exploring whether foodborne, waterborne, person--person outbreaks differ hospitalization rates using CDC outbreak data. project includes data cleaning, descriptive statistics, statistical analyses, visualizations. Results limitations documented separate vignettes. Project website: https://sherryzyw0120.github.io/finalproject/
